metadata.selection:
Build mini_demo_data.json: 11 whole sentences x 9 systems (99 rows) from the ONE dataset
fresh_confirm_greedy_450x9 of the artifact's full_method_out.json, plus the frozen config and weights.

Selection: sentences whose 9 greedy outputs all carry a known label (faithful/unfaithful), that contain BOTH
faithful and unfaithful outputs (so AUROC is defined within the demo), stratified over the 3 corpora and
the 3 complexity terciles; deterministic (seed 0).
